basic_info.description: Rarely available Townhouse with private entrance and greenbelt view!  2-bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 2 people = $119,900; 3 = $134,850; 4 = $149,850, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions.  Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, January 22,2025. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification are due on February 12,2025 at 5:00 PM. OPEN HOUSE DATES/TIMES.   Jan 26th 11 am-1 pm, Jan 23rd  5-7 pm, and Feb 2nd 11am-1pm. Fair Housing Opportunity.
